sources.articleTitle: Young smashes ton, Henry takes six as New Zealand crush India in fourth ODI

headline: New Zealand Defeats India In Fourth One Day International Match
seoTitle: New Zealand Beats India In ODI Cricket
metaDescription: New Zealand secures victory against India in the fourth ODI cricket match following a notable performance by Matt Henry and a century by Young.
aiSummaryBullets: New Zealand achieved a decisive victory over India in their latest one-day international cricket match.
Matt Henry contributed significantly to the result by taking six wickets during the game.
The batting lineup for New Zealand was led by a century score from Young.
aiContextParagraph: The recent international cricket match between New Zealand and India marked the fourth game of their one-day international series. The competition saw a strong performance from the New Zealand team, which ultimately resulted in a victory. Key to the outcome was the bowling performance of Matt Henry, who dismissed six Indian batters. Additionally, the team's total score was bolstered by an individual century from Young. These matches are part of ongoing bilateral cricket engagements between the two nations, drawing significant interest from sporting fans globally. The performance in this specific encounter has been highlighted for the notable statistics achieved by key players on the field, reflecting their roles in securing the win for their side.
